info.title: CertificateOfOrigins community - certificate-of-origin request (pure REST)
info.description:
Original messages: PC_NG_2280_MSG01_CertificateOfOriginRequest (request) and PC_NG_2281_MSG02_CertificateOfOriginRequestFeedback (feedback). V2: POST /CertificateOfOrigins_2280_CertOfOriginRequest.
Every field that changed from V2 carries x-legacy (xsdElement, v2Property, rule, reason); removed fields are listed under the parent's x-legacy.removed.
Rules (22.10.2026): R3 camelCase; identifiers are always Id, never ID (rule 3); R5 prefix that repeats the parent removed (rule 5); R6 spelling fixed (rule 6); R7 *Specified helper removed; an absent value is null (rule 7); R8 moved from the body to the URL: an HTTP method per operation instead of requestReasonCode (rule 8, alternative 2, customs-approved 28.10.2026); R9 wrapper that carries nothing removed; its fields moved up (rule 9); RH transmission details are not part of a REST body; the sender id is set by the message platform (MessageSenderId) (rule 9); RT type restored to the XSD type (Numeric = integer); V2 declared number.
Alternative 2 (customs-approved 28.10.2026): one endpoint and HTTP method per operation instead of requestReasonCode. The certificate number moves from the body to the URL.
The sender is the message platform's MessageSenderId header. Every operation on an existing certificate checks that the sender created it; otherwise 404 (new: legacy did not check).
Arrays keep their singular XSD names (invoiceDetail, itemDetail, exception, attachment). Attachments: externalAttachmentId only (content from the Documents service).

post.summary: Create a certificate of origin (request reasons 1, 2, 10, 12)

201.description: The certificate was created. exception[] carries reconciliation warnings, if any.

400.description:
Nothing was done: invalid input or a business rule. Legacy: exception[] under 200. Cases:
- Contract: a required field missing, or a length or range violated. errors[].field = the property path in PascalCase (e.g. AgentRequest.CertificateOfOriginTypeCode), detail = the rule that failed. With a single attribute error the platform reports it in title ("{field} is invalid") and detail, and errors[] is empty.
- Business: the message validation rejected the request and nothing was saved. errors[].errorCode = the legacy exceptionType (the UIMessage id), detail = its text, level = exceptionLevel. Legacy returned these under 200 in responseContentHeader.exception.
- RequestReasonCode: not 1, 2, 10 or 12.
- ExportDeclarationNum: the export declaration is in an amendment process.
- CertificateOfOrigin / NonManipulationCertificate: the body the certificate type requires is missing.
- CertificateOfOriginTypeCode: missing or unknown.

500.description: Server failure. Legacy: SoapResponseFault, or GeneralException under 200.
